project.description:
Deploys when the data for the current deploy keys is already staged.
Shell step (first): computes the auth and open deploy keys from build-spec.json (blame commit of the source_dataset_s3_url / source_destigmatized_dataset_s3_url lines) and checks that data/<key>/ is staged in the stack bucket (per-file: <stage prefix>manifest.tsv, legacy: <name>.tar), and that data/<auth key>/fence_mapping.json exists (the PSAMA deploy copies it into its container). If a variant is not staged, or the fence mapping is missing, the build FAILS before anything is built or scheduled, and says what to do: auth data staged per-file gets the mapping back from HPDS Data - Stage to Stack Bucket with HPDS_VARIANT=auth (it restores it from the staged metadata.json); auth data staged as a legacy tar must be restaged under a new deploy key.
This job does not stage data. Order of a data release: commit the new URLs in build-spec.json, run HPDS Data - Stage to Stack Bucket with HPDS_VARIANT=both (by hand), then run this job (or wait for its scheduled run). Rollback: put the old tar URLs back in build-spec.json (new deploy key), run HPDS Data - Stage to Stack Bucket with both, then this job.
When both variants are staged: Bash_Functions and PIC-SURE Pipeline run, then Deployment Pipeline is scheduled with the deploy keys.
